policy.title: Contractor Payment Policy
policy.subtitle: SpencerBuysHouses.com · Volunteer Homes, LLC
policy.qrScan: Scan to open on phone myfrank.ai/subcontractors
policy.wedDesc: Submit by 5 PM. Late invoices move to next week.
policy.friDesc: Pick up check after work is verified complete.
policy.thuFriDesc: Thu/Fri invoices are NOT paid that week.
policy.rule1Desc: No partial payments. Incomplete work = pushed to next week after re-inspection.
policy.rule2Title: Work Complete + Invoice by Wed 5 PM + W-9 = Paid Friday
policy.rule2Desc: All three conditions must be met. Meet all three and your check is ready Friday.
policy.rule3Desc: Miss Wed 5 PM and your invoice rolls to next cycle.
policy.rule4Title: No Thu/Fri Invoices Paid This Week
policy.rule4Desc: Thu/Fri invoices processed the following week only.
policy.w9Title: ⚠️ Required: W-9 Form — No W-9 = No Payment
policy.w9Desc: All contractors must submit a completed W-9 before receiving any payment. Required by law. Download:

invoiceForm.title: Send Invoice or Estimate
invoiceForm.noteInvoiceDesc: Invoices submitted after Wednesday 5 PM will be processed the following week. Work must be 100% complete to receive payment.
invoiceForm.noteEstimateDesc: Be as detailed as possible — list every task and material. Spencer will review and contact you.
invoiceForm.workDescHint: Be specific: list every task, material, and area of the house. Vague descriptions may delay payment.
invoiceForm.photosWarning: ⚠️ Required — invoices without photos will not be processed.
invoiceForm.photosHint: JPG, PNG, MP4, MOV accepted · Max 20 files
invoiceForm.w9No: No — I need to submit one
invoiceForm.w9WarningTitle: ⚠️ You must submit a W-9 before payment can be issued.
invoiceForm.successInvoiceDesc: Thank you. Your invoice has been received. If submitted by Wednesday at 5 PM and work is verified complete on Thursday, your check will be ready Friday.
invoiceForm.successEstimateDesc: Thank you. Your estimate has been received. Spencer will review it and contact you soon.
